name: NPM-VF
tagline: Automates manual insertion of odd-form through-hole parts

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-VF automates the insertion of odd-form components that are usually placed by hand. Configurable heads and feeders handle a wide range of parts, cameras check PCB holes and component orientation, and an optional clinch unit keeps leads from lifting and strengthens solder joints after flow soldering.

items: High productivity: a 2-beam, 2-head layout takes over work that needs three to five operators.
Non-stop production: stacked stick, radial tape and single or twin tray feeders can be refilled while the machine runs.
Four head types: nozzle, lead chuck, swing nozzle and body chuck.
Two-camera system (head camera and component camera) corrects PCB and component position and angle.
Optional cut and clinch with variable clinch pitch from 2.5 to 40 mm and insertion error detection. Requires the anvil conveyor; SMT parts cannot be used with this option.

rows: L 50 × W 50 to L 510 × W 460 mm
L 50 × W 50 to L 460 × W 400 mm

3-station head: max. 0.65 s/component
2-station head: max. 0.9 s/component
